title: Gameweek 7 Hall of Shame: the blanks, the cameos, and the captain who cost you
dek: The awards nobody wants from Gameweek 7, starting with B.Fernandes. Every one of them a real number, which is the problem.
body:
## The awards nobody wants

Every gameweek produces a handful of moments that are only funny once they cannot hurt you any more. Gameweek 7 has finished, so here they are.

Every award below is a real lookup against the round's data. Nothing here is invented, which is the part that stings.

:::takeaways
- **B.Fernandes** takes the Golden Blank at £11.8m.
- The field captained **Haaland** for 13 points.
- **Neto** scored 15 at 2.5% ownership.
:::

###  The Golden Blank

£11.8m buys a lot of things. On this occasion it bought 90 minutes of **B.Fernandes** and 1 point, which 29.2% of you had budgeted for rather differently.

###  The Armband Tax

The field captained **Haaland** and, for once, the field was right: 13 became 26. Enjoy it. This award is not usually a compliment.

###  The One You Did Not Own

**Neto** at 2.5% ownership returned 15. That is the differential working exactly as advertised, for almost nobody.

###  Cameo of the Week

**Hinshelwood** was on the pitch for 19 minutes and came off it with 6 points. Efficiency of that order should be studied, or at least owned.

###  Best Value on the Board

11 points for £4.5m. **Hato** did in one afternoon what some of your budget lines have not managed all season.

###  Mugged by the Woodwork

0.83 xGI, zero returns: **Smith** did everything but the last bit. Historically the last bit arrives. Historically it arrives the week after you sell him.

## For the record

The average manager scored **59**, the best score in the game was **122**, and the gap between them was 63 points — roughly a captain, a bench and a small amount of luck.

:::callout insight
Normal analytical service resumes on the rest of the desk. Gameweek 8 will produce its own list, and one of these entries will probably be yours.
:::
